metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Rust Cargo project in `output/` with no external dependencies:

- Manifest: [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- Binary entrypoint: [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)

What’s implemented:

- `iges` CLI with subcommands:
  - `parse --input ... --output ...`
  - `write --input ... --output ...`
  - `query --input ... --de ... --output ...`
  - `eval --input ... --de ... --t ... [--s ...] --output ...`
  - `roundtrip --input ... --output ...`
- Exit-code and diagnostic envelope handling (`ok:false` JSON on failures), including:
  - output-file diagnostics for `parse/query/eval`
  - stderr diagnostics for `write/roundtrip`
- Fixed-format IGES I/O:
  - 80-column line handling
  - `S/G/D/P/T` section parsing/writing
  - global-field delimiter/Hollerith parsing and validation
  - DE cross-reference checks for `view`, `xform_matrix`, `label_display`
  - required global positive-field checks
  - negative/unsupported entity-type checks
  - non-null `param_line_count` validation
  - degenerate line (Type 110) rejection
- Canonical JSON parsing/emission using an in-project JSON parser/serializer (std-only).
- Entity extraction by DE (`query`).
- Parametric evaluation (`eval`) for required curve/surface families, with transformation-matrix application ordering.

Build/run:

- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <arguments>`

Important note:

- The implementation includes full end-to-end IGES parsing/writing/eval infrastructure and explicit handling for eval-critical entity types, but not every one of the 87 entity schemas is fully expanded into typed canonical-field objects; non-expanded types are preserved through a raw-parameter fallback representation in JSON (`data.raw_parameters`).
